item.title: “Left me completely humiliated”- Jason Gillespie says some PCB decisions made him quit as Pakistan head coach
item.description: Former Australian pacer Jason Gillespie revealed why he quit as head coach of the Pakistan Test team. item.description: Furqan Bhat, a Jammu and Kashmir player, has been accused of "separatism" after being photographed wearing a Palestine flag on his helmet during a local cricket competition. item.title: Shreyas Iyer set to participate in simulation matches at CoE to test his fitness ahead of India comeback- Report
item.description: India ODI vice-captain Shreyas Iyer is reportedly doing well as BCCI charts his way back into the Indian team. Shreyas Iyer is undergoing recovery and rehab at the BCCI CoE in Bengaluru after suffering a spleen injury in Australia. Iyer's injury occurred during India's third and final one-day international against Australia on October 25. item.description: Mustafizur Rahman's availability for the Kolkata Knight Riders is the subject of intense discussion, and amidst the ongoing row about Bangladeshi players' involvement in the Indian Premier League (IPL), the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has revealed the schedule for India's tour for ODIs and T20Is. item.description: As per reports, Team India is likely to play additional T20Is on their tour of Sri Lanka in August this year as a show of support for the relief and rehabilitation activities following Cyclone Ditwah. item.description: Shubman Gill was the notable omission from India’s T20 World Cup 2026 squad announced last month.
